from: September book, night 1 (Like a Loving Father)
p1: King David wrote a happy song. He sang, “Bless the Lord, O my soul.” He was telling the real him, deep inside, to say thank you.
David sang, “Forget not all His good gifts.” He did not want to forget one good thing the Lord had done.
Then David thought of a loving dad. He sang that the Lord loves His people “like a father” loves his children.
p2: Picture a little child who falls down. A good dad hurries to hug and help. The Lord’s love is just like that. Jesus taught us to pray to “Our Father.”
Heavenly Father loves you even more. When you feel sad, His love is near. Tonight, thank Him for one good gift.
old: Long ago, a man named David wanted to thank Heavenly Father with his whole heart. So he sang a happy song: “Bless Heavenly Father, O my soul! I will remember all the good things He does!”
David remembered how kind Heavenly Father is. He forgives us when we’re sorry. He helps us feel better when we’re sad. He fills our lives with good things, like a warm hug that never ends.
“Heavenly Father loves us like the very best daddy,” David sang. “As high as the sky is above the earth, that’s how big His love is for us!”
And when we say we’re sorry, Heavenly Father takes our mistakes far, far away — as far as the sunrise is from the sunset. He remembers them no more.
Heavenly Father’s love is so big and so gentle. No matter what, He loves you with His whole heart, all the way to the sky and back.
